script:
set -u
V=/var/www/xinmo-site/vault-data.js
echo -n "VPS_SHA="; sha256sum "$V" | cut -d' ' -f1
echo -n "VPS_BYTES="; stat -c %s "$V"
curl -fsS "https://xinmo.work/vault-data.js?t=$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/v_online.js || { echo "ONLINE_DOWNLOAD_FAIL"; exit 1; }
echo -n "ONLINE_SHA="; sha256sum /tmp/v_online.js | cut -d' ' -f1
echo -n "ONLINE_BYTES="; stat -c %s /tmp/v_online.js
echo -n "ONLINE_HEAD="; head -c 40 /tmp/v_online.js
